title: E2E: User data isolation (CRITICAL SECURITY TEST)
description: Playwright e2e test verifying that two different users on the same browser have completely isolated data. This is THE critical test for the security fix.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Test setup: Clear all cookies, localStorage, Convex test data
Test: User A signs up, practices song, marks words learned
Test: User A's dashboard shows their progress (words > 0)
Test: User B signs up on SAME browser with different email
Test: User B's dashboard shows EMPTY progress (words = 0)
Test: User B practices different song, marks different words
Test: User B logs out, User A logs back in
Test: User A sees ONLY their original data, not User B's
All tests pass: bun run test:e2e --grep 'user-isolation'

blockedBy: Full E2E auth flow testing requires email delivery infrastructure (MailHog, Mailpit, or similar) to intercept magic links. Created partial test verifying security architecture passes - browser isolation, server-side auth enforcement, no client ID spoofing. User signup/login flow tests need email integration.
